# `<sl-detail-panel>` — Detail Panel

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

A non-modal panel that shows details for a selected item alongside the page, e.g. a document's review history next to the list it was selected from. Pair it with [sl-tab-group](tab-group.md) to organize content below the header.

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/detail-panel/detail-panel.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-icon-button>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contained` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the panel as a self-contained block: an outline on every side with rounded corners, like [table](table.md) and [card](card.md). Use it when the panel sits inside a grid with a gutter; leave it off for a sidebar attached to the edge of the page. |

## Events

Listen with `addEventListener`, `(event-name)` in Angular or `@event-name` in Lit. Data is on `event.detail`.

| Event | `event.detail` | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sl-request-close` | `{ source: 'close-button' }` | Emitted when the user clicks the close button. Calling `event.preventDefault()` will stop the panel from being treated as closed, e.g. if closing requires confirmation. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `label` | The panel's title, shown in the header. |
| `meta` | A secondary line shown below the title, e.g. a revision code. |
| `actions` | Extra `<sl-icon-button>` elements shown in the header, before the close button, e.g. settings or edit. |
| (default) | The panel's content, shown below the header. Commonly an `<sl-tab-group>`. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `header` | The panel's header. Wraps the title, meta line, actions, and close button. |
| `title` | The container that wraps the label slot. |
| `meta` | The container that wraps the meta slot. |
| `actions` | The container that wraps the actions slot. |
| `close-button` | The close button, an `<sl-icon-button>`. |
| `close-button__base` | The close button's exported `base` part. |
| `body` | The panel's content, below the header. |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--border-color` | `var(--sl-border-subtle)` | The color of the border, used by the start border and by the outline of the `contained` variant. |
| `--border-radius` | `var(--sl-border-radius-medium)` | The corner radius of the `contained` variant. |

## Documentation and examples

Detail panels show more information about a selected item without taking over the screen the way a
[dialog](dialog.md) does, e.g. a document's review history shown next to the list it was selected from. The
header has a `label` slot for the title, a `meta` slot for a secondary line such as a revision code, an `actions` slot
for extra header buttons, and a close button. The default slot holds the panel's content, commonly an
[`sl-tab-group`](tab-group.md).

> Detail panels only provide the header/body shell — they don't position or animate themselves. Place one in a layout
> column, a fixed-position sidebar, or similar, the way you would any other block-level element.

```html
<sl-detail-panel style="height: 20rem; max-width: 24rem;">
  <span slot="label">Statement of Work.pdf</span>
  <span slot="meta">Revision 4 &middot; Expiring in 12 days</span>

  <div style="padding: var(--sl-spacing-medium);">
    This agreement was last reviewed on September 18, 2026 and is due for renewal.
  </div>
</sl-detail-panel>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/detail-panel/detail-panel.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-detail-panel-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-detail-panel style="height: 20rem; max-width: 24rem;">
      <span slot="label">Statement of Work.pdf</span>
      <span slot="meta">Revision 4 &middot; Expiring in 12 days</span>

      <div style="padding: var(--sl-spacing-medium);">
        This agreement was last reviewed on September 18, 2026 and is due for renewal.
      </div>
    </sl-detail-panel>
  `
})
export class DetailPanelExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### With tabs and a selection list

Combine the panel with [`sl-tab-group`](tab-group.md) and a list of
[`sl-selectable-item`](selectable-item.md) rows for a richer detail view.

```html
<sl-detail-panel class="detail-panel-demo" style="height: 24rem; max-width: 28rem;">
  <span slot="label">Statement of Work.pdf</span>
  <span slot="meta">Revision 4 &middot; Expiring in 12 days</span>

  <sl-tab-group style="height: 100%;">
    <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="documents">Related documents</sl-tab>
    <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="history">History</sl-tab>

    <sl-tab-panel name="documents">
      <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: var(--sl-spacing-medium);">
        <sl-selectable-item value="doc-1" checked>
          Statement of Work.pdf
          <span slot="meta">Oct 3, 2026</span>
        </sl-selectable-item>
        <sl-selectable-item value="doc-2">
          Amendment 1.pdf
          <span slot="meta">Sep 18, 2026</span>
        </sl-selectable-item>
      </div>
    </sl-tab-panel>

    <sl-tab-panel name="history">
      <div style="padding: var(--sl-spacing-medium);">No changes recorded yet.</div>
    </sl-tab-panel>
  </sl-tab-group>
</sl-detail-panel>

<script>
  const panel = document.querySelector('.detail-panel-demo');
  panel.addEventListener('sl-request-close', () => panel.remove());
</script>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/detail-panel/detail-panel.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/selectable-item/selectable-item.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab-group/tab-group.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab-panel/tab-panel.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab/tab.js';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA, signal } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-detail-panel-with-tabs-and-a-selection-list-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    @if (visible()) {
      <sl-detail-panel style="height: 24rem; max-width: 28rem;" (sl-request-close)="visible.set(false)">
        <span slot="label">Statement of Work.pdf</span>
        <span slot="meta">Revision 4 &middot; Expiring in 12 days</span>

        <sl-tab-group style="height: 100%;">
          <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="documents">Related documents</sl-tab>
          <sl-tab slot="nav" panel="history">History</sl-tab>

          <sl-tab-panel name="documents">
            <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: var(--sl-spacing-medium);">
              @for (doc of documents; track doc.value) {
                <sl-selectable-item [value]="doc.value" [checked]="doc.value === selected()">
                  {{ doc.name }}
                  <span slot="meta">{{ doc.date }}</span>
                </sl-selectable-item>
              }
            </div>
          </sl-tab-panel>

          <sl-tab-panel name="history">
            <div style="padding: var(--sl-spacing-medium);">No changes recorded yet.</div>
          </sl-tab-panel>
        </sl-tab-group>
      </sl-detail-panel>
    }
  `
})
export class DetailPanelWithTabsAndASelectionListExampleComponent {
  readonly documents = [
    { value: 'doc-1', name: 'Statement of Work.pdf', date: 'Oct 3, 2026' },
    { value: 'doc-2', name: 'Amendment 1.pdf', date: 'Sep 18, 2026' }
  ];

  readonly selected = signal('doc-1');

  // The panel hides itself when the close request is not prevented. Driving it from a signal instead keeps
  // Angular as the single owner of what is on screen.
  readonly visible = signal(true);
}
```

### With header actions

Add `<sl-icon-button>` elements to the `actions` slot for extra header buttons, e.g. to add or edit the item. They're
shown before the close button.

```html
<sl-detail-panel style="height: 12rem; max-width: 24rem;">
  <span slot="label">Details</span>

  <sl-icon-button slot="actions" name="plus-lg" library="system" label="Add"></sl-icon-button>
  <sl-icon-button slot="actions" name="pencil" library="system" label="Edit"></sl-icon-button>

  <div style="padding: var(--sl-spacing-medium);">Panel content</div>
</sl-detail-panel>
```

### Contained

Set `contained` to draw the panel as a self-contained block, with an outline on every side and rounded corners like
[table](table.md) and [card](card.md). Use it when the panel sits in a grid next to other blocks; leave
it off for a sidebar attached to the edge of the page.

```html
<sl-detail-panel contained style="height: 12rem; max-width: 24rem;">
  <span slot="label">Statement of Work.pdf</span>
  <span slot="meta">Revision 4</span>

  <div style="padding: var(--sl-spacing-medium);">Panel content</div>
</sl-detail-panel>
```

### Listening for the close request

Clicking the close button emits `sl-request-close`. Call `event.preventDefault()` to keep the panel open, e.g. if
closing requires confirming unsaved changes first.

```html
<sl-detail-panel class="detail-panel-confirm" style="height: 12rem; max-width: 24rem;">
  <span slot="label">Amendment 1.pdf</span>
  <span slot="meta">Unsaved changes</span>
  <div style="padding: var(--sl-spacing-medium);">Closing this panel will discard your unsaved edits.</div>
</sl-detail-panel>

<script>
  const confirmPanel = document.querySelector('.detail-panel-confirm');
  confirmPanel.addEventListener('sl-request-close', event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    alert('Save or discard your changes before closing.');
  });
</script>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/detail-panel/detail-panel.js';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-detail-panel-listening-for-the-close-request-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sl-detail-panel style="height: 12rem; max-width: 24rem;" (sl-request-close)="handleRequestClose($event)">
      <span slot="label">Amendment 1.pdf</span>
      <span slot="meta">Unsaved changes</span>
      <div style="padding: var(--sl-spacing-medium);">Closing this panel will discard your unsaved edits.</div>
    </sl-detail-panel>
  `
})
export class DetailPanelListeningForTheCloseRequestExampleComponent {
  // sl-request-close is cancelable: preventing it stops the panel from hiding itself.
  handleRequestClose(event: Event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    alert('Save or discard your changes before closing.');
  }
}
```
